reconcileDrift: Inspected current drift after the root integration diagnostic. Existing shared/compose changes are the returned foundation, theme, assets and build wiring that form the baseline; no user-owned files are removed, and the new assignment is constrained to product UI and its design-review documentation.
goal: Replace the foundation demo with the complete Material 3-first SproutPace UI for all sixteen approved screens and their required loading/content/empty/error/permission/confirmation states, production EN/RU strings, adaptive compact/rail/list-detail behavior, keyboard semantics, minimum touch targets and deterministic previews. Use the approved assets and the prior Lazyweb findings; do not change product scope or run Gradle.
acceptanceCriteria: All 16 approved ScreenId values have production Compose rendering and are reachable through root/navigation callbacks without product-scope additions.
Every user-facing string is a production Compose resource with complete EN and RU variants; no hardcoded authored UI copy remains.
Compact uses bottom navigation, wider layouts use rail/list-detail where specified, and safe insets plus 200 percent font scale remain usable.
Primary actions, controls and custom click targets expose roles/labels and meet 48dp minimum targets; keyboard traversal is deterministic.
Deterministic light/dark, RU, large-text and adaptive previews exist for primary and critical states, ready for Paparazzi discovery.
A design decision note records the already completed Lazyweb evidence and the exact patterns applied; post-golden review remains a later root-owned gate.
No Gradle execution, ledger edits, external project creation or scope changes are performed by the specialist.
